edits.value: Spec review against NHIA/BLI 3-in-1 batch withdrawal format (02_Stop3Of1, rev. 114.12.12): field mappings corrected, field 15 added, C/M/O, data types and Report Matrix updated.

Employees leaving whose LI(+EI)/OAI, LP and NHI are filed by the same unit (insurance type 2). NHI-only withdrawals ($hr.insurance_coverage = 3) are filed with NHIA, not in this batch (guide 02_Stop3Of1, rev. 114.12.12, field 6 and reminder).

File on the separation date (離職當日). LI/EI coverage ends at 24:00 on the day the filing reaches BLI; NHI ends at 24:00 on the day the withdrawal reason occurs (BLI form 承表L rev. 113.06, instr. 6). Dependants' NHI is transferred out automatically: no dependant rows. LP: the filing date is taken as the last LP contribution date; if different, file the LP stop form separately with BLI (承表L note 3). Electronic batch: Excel upload in the NHIA multi-certificate system; the official guide defines column order, values and notes only (no start/end positions, no official TXT layout).
C = Conditional, M = Mandatory, O = Optional

$legal_entity_hr.labor_insure_id - first 8 characters, as text (keep leading zeros). DD V3.3 types this field as Number although the 9th character is a letter: TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA (DD also has insurance_certification_number, '8 digits + 1 text').
保險證號檢查碼 (1位英文字母)
Always "2" (guide rev. 114.12.12 accepts only "2" = 勞(就)保/災保/勞退/健保). Employees with $hr.insurance_coverage = 3 (NHI only) are excluded from this batch.
To withdraw "勞(就)保/災保/勞退/健保" (LI/EI, OAI, LP and NHI), enter "2".
Value "3" (NHI only) is no longer in the guide.
NHI-only changes are filed separately with NHIA (guide reminder).

Employee nationality: no field in DD V3.3 -> NEW DD FIELD (proposed): Employee Nationality (+ permanent-resident foreign professional flag for 'L'); TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA. Logic: nationality = TW -> blank; permanent-resident foreign professional (永居外專) -> 'L'; $hr.spouse_nationality = TW and nationality = CN -> '2'; $hr.spouse_nationality = TW and other nationality (incl. Hong Kong/Macau) -> '1'; otherwise 'Y'. Do not use $hr.residential_status (tax residency).
For "Permanent-resident foreign professional" (永居外專), enter "L". "Foreign spouse" ("1") includes Hong Kong/Macau spouses.

IF(EQUALS(field 8; ''); $hr.name; FULLWIDTH(UPPERCASE($hr.name))) - nationals: Chinese name ($hr.name, DD V3.3 ID Information 'name' 名字); foreigners with English names: full name in full-width uppercase (e.g. ＤＡＶＩＤ), max. 200 characters. FULLWIDTH: TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA (no such function known in the formula engine; also confirm that $hr.name holds the English full name of foreigners).
Chinese names: nationals at least 2 characters, foreigners at least 1. English names: full name in full-width uppercase letters. Maximum 200 characters.
(居留證統一證號或護照號碼)

IF(EQUALS($hr.id_type::key; '3'); $hr.passport_number; $hr.id_card_number) - nationals: national ID; foreigners: ARC unified ID number (id_type 2) or passport (id_type 3), the same ID used at enrolment. Replaces $hr.residential_status (tax residency).
被保險人居留證統一證號
IF(EQUALS($hr.id_type::key; '2'); $hr.id_card_number; '') - ARC unified ID number; blank for nationals.
$hr.health_insurance_withdraw_reason_code::key (1 = withdrawal, 2 = transfer out). Default when the HR field is empty: TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA (proposal: 2 for a resignation).
$hr.health_insurance_withdraw_reason_explanation::key (if field 13 = 1: M, E, U; if 2: 1, 2, 3, 4). Default when empty: TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA (proposal: 1 = resignation).
For those who lost eligibility under NHI Act art. 8 or 9 (loss of nationality or household registration moved out; residence permit expired), enter "U".
Text derived from field 14: M -> 死亡; E -> 失蹤; U -> 喪失資格; 1 -> 離職; 2 -> 退休; 3 -> 停、歇業; 4 -> 退會 (short labels of the guide, not the mapper Local Value).

NOTE (guide rev. 114.12.12): ※ When the insured person withdraws from NHI, all dependants are transferred out; no dependant data is entered. ※ NHI Act art. 8: loss of nationality or household registration moved out; art. 9: residence permit expired. ※ NHI-only changes are filed separately with NHIA.
Not prescribed by the official format guide (02_Stop3Of1, rev. 114.12.12).

Used to notify BLI and NHIA together, in one 3-in-1 batch, of employee withdrawals so that LI/EI/OAI, LP and NHI coverage stops. The batch can be uploaded in the NHIA multi-certificate system (申報批次勞健合一 EXCEL) or in the BLI e-service (合一申報, single and batch) (NHIA East Division flyer; BLI manual ch. 9, FAQ 2 and 6).

Date the NHI withdrawal reason occurred (guide field 16; NHI ends at 24:00 on that day, 承表L instr. 6). Field 14 = 1, 2, 3, 4 (transfer out): CONCAT(PREPAD(SUBTRACT(DATE_FORMAT($employee.last_working_date; 'yyyy'); 1911); 3; '0'); DATE_FORMAT($employee.last_working_date; 'MMdd')). Field 14 = M (death), E (missing 6 months), U (loss of eligibility): date of that event - no DD field -> NEW DD FIELD (proposed): NHI withdrawal reason date; TO BE CONFIRMED BY MOHIT/BA.
